ACCESS_CHANGES_TITLE: Member access will change with this plan
ACCESS_CHANGES_DESCRIPTION: When the change takes effect, roles and feature access not included in the new plan will end. They will not return automatically after a future upgrade.
PLAN_CHANGE_SCHEDULE_DESCRIPTION: Review the effective date and the exact impact before scheduling this change.
RECONFIGURE_AFTER_UPGRADE: Set up member access again after a future upgrade.
ENDED_ACCESS_TITLE: Ended access will not return automatically
REVIEW_STEP_DESCRIPTION: Load the current plan change details first. If member access must change, review every impact and choose which feature access to keep.
ACCESS_INFORMATION_CHANGED_DESCRIPTION: The plan change has not been scheduled. Load the current schedule and review it again before continuing.
REVIEW_FAILED_TITLE: The impact could not be loaded
REVIEW_FAILED_DESCRIPTION: The plan change has not been scheduled. Try loading the current details again.
SCHEDULE_FAILED_TITLE: The plan change could not be scheduled
SCHEDULE_FAILED_DESCRIPTION: The current plan and member access are unchanged. Review the schedule shown here and try again.
CHANGE_SCHEDULED_DESCRIPTION: The plan change is scheduled to take effect on {{date}}. Your current plan remains unchanged until then.
CHANGE_SCHEDULED_WITH_ACCESS_DESCRIPTION: The plan change is scheduled to take effect on {{date}}. Member access will update to the reviewed result then and will not change before that time.
NO_ACCESS_CHANGES_TITLE: No member access changes are needed
NO_ACCESS_CHANGES_DESCRIPTION: Current member roles, invitations, and feature access are not affected by this plan change, so it can be scheduled directly.
NO_ACCESS_CHANGES_CHECKOUT_DESCRIPTION: Current member roles, invitations, and feature access are not affected. Continue to secure checkout to request this plan.
MEMBER_ACCESS_REVIEWED: This member's access will be updated for the new plan
RESPONSIBILITY_WILL_REMAIN: The “{{responsibility}}” role will stay the same
CUSTOM_ROLE_WILL_END: This custom role will no longer be available
CUSTOM_ROLE_WILL_REMAIN: This custom role will stay available
BILLING_RESPONSIBILITY_WILL_END: Billing management access affected by the new plan will end
BILLING_RESPONSIBILITY_WILL_REMAIN: Plan and billing management access will stay the same
FEATURE_RESPONSIBILITY_WILL_END: Feature access management affected by the new plan will end
FEATURE_RESPONSIBILITY_WILL_REMAIN: Feature access management will stay the same
INVITATION_WILL_END: Role choices in this invitation that the new plan does not support will expire
INVITATION_WILL_REMAIN: Role choices in this invitation will stay the same
INVITATION_LINK_WILL_END: Role choices in this link that the new plan does not support will expire
INVITATION_LINK_WILL_REMAIN: Role choices in this link will stay the same
WILL_RECHECK: Checked again when the change takes effect
FEATURE_ACCESS_DESCRIPTION: Choose each member who should keep access after the new plan takes effect. Access not selected here will end.
SELECTION_CHANGED_TITLE: The impact does not include your latest choices yet
SELECTION_CHANGED_DESCRIPTION: Update the impact so the recorded result exactly matches the people selected here.
RETAINED_ACCESS_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT: I reviewed the impact on members, roles, invitations, and feature access, and understand these adjustments happen only when the plan change takes effect.
